description: The only masked areas (PLAN.md, Parity harness): spinners, the typing demo, the random progress value, and the oracle's theme-toggle animation and maintenance-banner link color. A mask applies to an aligned element when its selector matches it on either side. contents: the element's descendants and its own text are not collected or compared (the element itself, its attributes and styles still are). text: the text of the element and its descendants is not compared. attributes: these attribute names are not compared on the element. properties: these computed longhands are not compared on the element. pixels: true covers the element's boxes on both screenshots; a selector string covers that selector's boxes instead (screenshots never gate). Masked parts are also left out of the alignment's subtree signatures. result.json lists these masks and how many elements each covered per cell.

masks.reason: The loading spinner is an SVG whose internal animation cannot be frozen; its computed styles are stable and stay compared.

The homepage and /demo typing demo types code on a timer and drives the form beside it, so its content depends on when it is read. The article's own box (fixed height) stays compared; the behavior suite checks the demo.
/docs/progress renders a random value (5 to 94) and replaces it every 5 s.

masks.selector: article[aria-label="Progress example"] > footer > pre > code > :nth-child(1 of .attr-value:not(.punctuation))
masks.reason: The highlighted code under the /docs/progress example prints the same random value in one token: the first attr-value token that is not punctuation (value="NN" comes before max="100"). Only that token's text, and the transform-origin and perspective-origin Firefox derives from its size, are not compared; every other token, its classes and the pre stay compared. Its digits shift the rest of the line, so the screenshot covers the whole pre (pixels never gate).

From Phase 4 the code under the /docs progress example is longer than its pre at 375 px, and femto's pre > code min-width: min-content (site/vendor/femto/css/content/code.css:47-50) makes the code as wide as that line. A one-digit value then makes it one character narrower than a two-digit one: 344.5 against 352.906 px in Chrome at 375 (p4-gate-loads-1 and p6-gate-loads-1, /docs and /docs?theme=jade). Only the code's width and inline-size, and the transform-origin and perspective-origin derived from them, are not compared; its height, its other styles and every token but the value stay compared.

The oracle's animated toggle icon (toggles.dev): React adds moon after hydration when the page is dark, and the circle and rays then scale over 260 ms (the cutout path's d moves too). In Safari 27.2 the transition can start after the harness's freeze, so the oracle differed from itself in the theme-dark leg on a light OS (p0-self-safari-light-locked, 2026-11-01: 36 transform records in 18 cells, and 6 harness errors on /docs/forms/input). The site no longer has this icon (Decision 16), so only these two animated longhands of its parts are not compared; everything else about the SVG still is.

The link in the oracle's maintenance banner: the banner takes the inverse theme, and React sets its data-theme after hydration, so on a dark page it flips from dark to light and the link's color and text-decoration-color then transition over 0.2 s. Safari 27.2 once read it mid-transition without the freeze seeing the transition (p0-self-safari-dark, 2026-11-01: 16 records in /docs/link dark 375, side A rgb(93, 107, 137), side B rgb(135, 145, 165), no harness error). The site drops the banner (Decision 5), so only its color and the longhands that follow currentColor are not compared; the banner, its data-theme, the link's text and its other styles still are.

The oracle's animated check (Check.jsx with isAnimated, the current color's check in the header's version picker on the /docs/version-picker routes): its stroke draws in with animation: check 0.2s ease-out forwards, stroke-dashoffset from 22px to 0. Safari 27.2 can still be running it when the page is read, so the oracle differed from itself (p6-self-safari-dark-2, 2026-11-07: 1 record in each of /docs/version-picker/fuchsia dark 1600 and /docs/version-picker/jade theme-dark 1300, 0px against 0.049004px, one per side). The site has no such icon (Decision 17's character), so only that one animated longhand is not compared; the path's d, stroke, dasharray and every other style of the check still are.
